trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Age 6 months to less than 13 years of age (<13)

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Clinical diagnosis of acute tonsillitis/pharyngitis caused by Streptococcus pyogenes based on:

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: A positive result from a rapid detection throat swab test for Group A streptococcal antigen and submission of a throat swab specimen for bacterial culture, identification, and antibiotic-susceptibility testing; and

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: A sore and scratchy throat and/or pain on swallowing (odynophagia) together with at least 2 of the following clinical signs:

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Tonsil and/or pharyngeal erythema and/or exudate;

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Cervical adenopathy;

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Uvular edema;

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Fever

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Symptoms that collectively suggest nonstreptococcal T/P (eg, laryngitis, coryza, conjunctivitis, diarrhea, cough)

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: History of positive throat culture for Streptococcus pyogenes in the absence of clinical signs and symptoms of T/P

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Infection of the deep tissues of the upper respiratory tract (eg, epiglottitis, retropharyngeal or buccal cellulitis, or abscess of the retropharynx, tonsil, or peritonsillar area) or of the suprapharyngeal respiratory tract and its connecting structures (eg, sinusitis, otitis media, or orbital/periorbital cellulitis)

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: History of rheumatic heart disease

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Females of childbearing potential (ie, have reached menarche)

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Known congenital prolonged QT syndrome

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Known or suspected uncorrected hypokalemia (≤3 mmol/L [mEq/L]), or hypomagnesemia or bradycardia (<50 bpm)

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Myasthenia gravis

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Known impaired renal function, as shown by creatinine clearance ≤25 mL/min

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Is being treated with drugs not permitted by the study protocol ie, cisapride, pimozide, astemizole, terfenadine, ergotamine, dihydroergotamine, Class IA (eg, quinidine and procainamide) or Class III (eg, dofetilide) antiarrhythmic agents, simvastatin, lovastatin and atorvastatin

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Is currently being treated with systemic antibacterials or has been treated with systemic antibacterials within 14 days prior to enrollment

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Has been treated with any investigational medication within the last 30 days

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Has been treated with rifampicin, phenytoin, carbamazepine, or St. John's wort within the last 2 weeks

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: History of hypersensitivity or intolerance to macrolides, penicillins, or cephalosporins

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Previous enrollment in this study or previous treatment with telithromycin

trial_title: TELI TON - Telithromycin in Tonsillitis
criterion_text: Children of the investigator or subinvestigator, research assistant, pharmacist, study coordinator, other staff, or relative thereof directly involved in the conduct of the protocol

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Normal lung function, defined as (Knudson 1976/1984 predicted set): FVC of > 80 % of that predicted for gender, ethnicity, age and height FEV1 of > 80 % of that predicted for gender, ethnicity, age and height FEV1/FVC ratio of > .75

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Oxygen saturation of > 94 % and normal blood pressure (Systolic between 150 - 90, Diastolic between 90-60 mm Hg)

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Symptom Score no greater than 6 (out of a possible 24) for total symptom score with a value no greater than 2 for any one score.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Negative methacholine inhalation challenge as performed in the screening protocol. (Less than a 20% decrease in FEV1 at a maximum methacholine concentration of 10 mg/ml)

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: --Negative pregnancy test for females

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Negative allergy skin test (AST)

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: History of episodic wheezing, chest tightness, or shortness of breath after age of 6 years consistent with asthma, or physician diagnosed asthma after age of 6 years.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Positive methacholine test.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: FEV1 of at least 80% of predicted and FEV1/FVC ratio of at least .70 (without use of bronchodilating medications for 12 hours)

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Allergic sensitization to at least one of the following allergen preparations: (House Dust Mite f, House dust mite p, Cockroach, Tree mix, Grass Mix, Weed Mix, Mold Mix 1, Mold Mix 2, Rat, Mouse, Guinea Pig, Rabbit, Cat or Dog) confirmed by positive AST.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Negative allergy skin test as performed in the screening protocol.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Any chronic medical condition considered by the PI as a contraindication to the exposure study including significant cardiovascular disease, diabetes requiring medication, chronic renal disease, or chronic thyroid disease.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Physician directed emergency treatment for an asthma exacerbation within the preceding 12 months.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Use of systemic steroid therapy within the preceding 12 months for an asthma exacerbation. All use of systemic steroids in the last year will be reviewed by a study physician.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Use of inhaled steroids, cromolyn or leukotriene inhibitors (montelukast or zafirlukast) except for use of cromolyn exclusively prior to exercise.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Use of daily theophylline within the past month.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Use of tricyclics and MAO inhibitors

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Pregnancy or nursing a baby.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Cigarette smoking > 1 pack per month.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Nighttime symptoms of cough or wheeze greater than 1x/week at baseline (not during a clearly recognized viral induced asthma exacerbation) which would be characteristic of a person of moderate or severe persistent asthma as outlined in the current NHLBI guidelines for diagnosis and management of asthma.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Exacerbation of asthma more than 2x/week which would be characteristic of a person of moderate or severe persistent asthma as outlined in the current NHLBI guidelines for diagnosis and management of asthma.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Daily requirement for albuterol due to asthma symptoms (cough, wheeze, chest tightness) which would be characteristic of a person of moderate or severe persistent asthma as outlined in the current NHLBI guidelines for diagnosis and management of asthma. (Not to include prophylactic use of albuterol prior to exercise).

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Viral upper respiratory tract infection within 2 weeks of challenge.

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Any acute infection requiring antibiotics within 2 weeks of challenge

trial_title: A Study of Inhalation of 20,000 EU CCRE in Normal Volunteers Compared to Allergic Asthmatic Individuals
criterion_text: Receipt of LAIV (Live Attenuated Influenza Vaccine), also know as FluMist®, within the prior 14 days
